quote: Transformer and switchgear sales to utility customers were 68% of revenue in fiscal 2025, up from 61% in fiscal 2024, as utilities advanced grid-hardening programmes.
Backlog at year end was $412 million, of which approximately 70% is scheduled for delivery within twelve months.
We source grain-oriented electrical steel from three suppliers, two of which are outside the United States; tariff changes or allocation could delay deliveries.
Gross margin was 27.4% compared with 25.9% in the prior-year quarter, reflecting pricing actions taken in the second half of fiscal 2025.
We expect lead times on large power transformers to remain above 80 weeks through the end of the calendar year.
The second plant line is on schedule for commissioning in the fourth quarter; we have not yet booked orders against that capacity.
The company announced a five-year supply agreement with a regional transmission operator for distribution transformers, with minimum annual volumes.
Two customers each accounted for more than 10% of revenue in the quarter.
